sources.title: source
sources.finding: Apache-2.0 public repository includes desktop, web, local backend, UI, Agent CLI/runtime and SDK. Desktop uses Electron 44; zcode --web defaults to loopback and automatically requires token auth on non-loopback unless explicitly disabled.

sources.title: android
sources.finding: Android source wraps remote-control web UI in Kotlin/Compose and Android WebView. Source presence does not establish a public supported installer or app-store release.

sources.title: install
sources.finding: Published installers cover macOS 13+, Windows and Linux, x64/ARM64 by platform. Login or API-key setup is offered.

sources.title: models
sources.finding: Z.ai/BigModel Coding Plans and API-key connections are separate routes. Custom Anthropic/OpenAI-compatible providers, single signed-in identity, team quota selection and five-day Start Plan are documented. Provider account economics remain external.

sources.title: agents
sources.finding: ZCode Agent is the built-in harness. Global/root AGENTS.md, effort controls, plan/read-only versus full-access modes, context attachments and project-free tasks are documented.

sources.title: task-doc
sources.finding: Task list organizes conversations by project/group/recent/unread with pin/archive/search. Removing a project is distinct from deleting its task data and does not remove repository files.

sources.title: subagents
sources.finding: Built-in general-purpose and Explore roles plus user/project Markdown roles support model, effort, tool allowlist and instruction injection. Main agent dispatches and reads child results.

sources.title: workflow-doc
sources.finding: Dynamic workflows use approved scripts, phases and concurrent child runs, inspectable progress, resumable completed steps and saved .dwf.ts files. Concurrency defaults between 4 and 16 based on CPU cores.

sources.title: remote-doc
sources.finding: SSH, WSL and existing Docker targets receive a runtime; remote tasks continue after desktop disconnect, but service restart interrupts runs. Config transfer is one-way and does not sync chats/memory.

sources.title: phone-doc
sources.finding: Same-account/same-region browser remote control connects through a running desktop, one phone connection at a time. Desktop offline blocks phone access even if remote execution continues.

sources.title: bot-doc
sources.finding: Bound Telegram/WeChat/Feishu/Lark chats can create and resume sessions. Bot-origin tasks use fixed full access; private binding and project access differ from human team membership.

sources.title: memory-doc
sources.finding: Opt-in project-local Markdown memory extraction follows successful turns; users can edit/delete files. Local projects only; index truncation and selected-model transmission are disclosed.

sources.title: automation-doc
sources.finding: Local schedules retain definitions and run history, prevent overlapping duplicate runs, retry dispatch with bounded backoff, skip triggers missed by five minutes and allow at most 20 definitions. App and awake computer required.

sources.title: idle-doc
sources.finding: Eligible Coding Plan accounts queue local tasks using spare provider capacity. Automatic runs do not consume plan quota, but manual follow-ups do; local desktop must remain online, and failed runs are not automatically requeued.

sources.title: safety-doc
sources.finding: Default Ask before changes, project-scoped allow rules and explicit full-access confirmation. Ordinary questions may time out; permission and plan approval requests wait indefinitely.

sources.title: undo-doc
sources.finding: Last-turn edits may replace reply/history; reset and undo restore only recoverable file changes after safety checks. Terminal-command changes are not fully covered.

sources.title: tools-doc
sources.finding: Native Review, terminal, file previews, browser/element context and Sites entry. Built-in browser is desktop-only; remote execution and local computer control are distinct.

sources.title: usage-doc
sources.finding: Coding Plan dashboard reports provider quota/credit trends and service health, separately from local session tokens. Reset cards and account allowance are not API invoice reconciliation.

sources.title: sessions
sources.finding: Stable task/workspace IDs, pinned/archived/deleted metadata and conversation identity are stored separately from grouping. Groups are organizational, not an issue dependency/assignee model.

sources.title: control
sources.finding: Trusted caller scopes are injected outside model input. List/read/create/fork/send/interrupt/rename/archive/open/wait control sessions with stable IDs and request receipts. Source/epoch/revision gaps invalidate waits rather than report completion; mutation cancellation is not automatic replay.

sources.title: delegate
sources.locator: liveChildRuns; durable child metadata; coordinator-response.ts; docs/subagent-respond-to-coordinator.md
sources.finding: Child contexts/results persist separately; SendMessage/RespondToCoordinator route through the owning runtime. Coordinator ack means queued, not read/durably delivered. No durable inbox, retries or read receipts survive restart in that response path.

sources.title: todo
sources.finding: Session-local checklist reads and whole-list writes use pending/in_progress/completed plus priority. They are not a standalone shared issue tracker or distributed claim system.

sources.title: plan
sources.finding: Exiting plan mode requires explicit human approval even after entering from full access; deny stops or supplies feedback. Project allow rules are persisted. Sending to an existing broader-mode child is separately permitted.

sources.title: goal
sources.finding: Goal checks use a separate no-tool model request over history. Invalid JSON, attempted tools and verifier infrastructure failures return passed:true with an explanatory reason; user cancellation pauses the target. No exact-revision CI release gate follows.

sources.title: workflow
sources.finding: Workflow scripts, run lineage, arguments, child invocations and journaled outcomes enable resumed or amended runs. Host failures settle interrupted; cancellation stops child work. Orchestration-script isolation does not sandbox the coding tools it delegates.

sources.title: schedule
sources.finding: Utility-process scheduler polls every 20 seconds, transactionally claims due work, tracks run IDs and bounded dispatch retries, skips missed windows and recovers stale claims. These are local dispatch semantics, not a distributed compute cluster.

sources.title: worktrees
sources.finding: Managed worktrees are created detached at a chosen commit, optionally carrying patches/untracked/declared ignored files. Atomic bucket ownership limits cleanup and dirty/in-use worktrees resist deletion. They separate code, not OS credentials or network.

sources.title: runner
sources.finding: Commands use host child_process.spawn, bounded time/output and process-tree cancellation. Legacy sandbox request/telemetry fields remain, but the inspected adapter no longer adds an OS sandbox. Docker remote targets are a separate user-configured boundary.

sources.title: budget
sources.finding: Per-runtime token accounting resets on resume and anchors actual user input; child runtimes have separate counters. Goal budgets and provider request retries are not a shared invoice-level spend cap. Retry routing does not replay tool actions.

sources.title: tool-schedule
sources.finding: Tool dependency ordering rejects cycles; concurrency defaults to ten and safety metadata controls parallel groups. This does not deduplicate repository tests across independent tasks or schedule by free RAM.

sources.title: git
sources.locator: getDiff; getBranchComparison; stagePaths; commit; push; gitCheckpointService.ts
sources.finding: Native repository status/diff/branch/stage/commit/push and scoped checkpoint compare/restore. External PR authority and deployment gates are not implemented by these local Git methods.

sources.title: share
sources.locator: public projection; artifact discovery/integrity; importableArtifactExtension; conversationShareHttpClient.ts
sources.finding: Share/export paths project conversation and artifact snapshots, validate allowed types and hashes on import, and call a separate hosted share API. Snapshot sharing is not live multiuser editing; server retention/authorization implementation is outside the public client.

sources.title: privacy
sources.finding: ARMS, event reporting and updater are build-time configurable; absent private defaults/env they are off. Official internal defaults are excluded from public export. Agent OTLP has separate settings. Event sender includes user/device/session IDs and sanitized extra details; no universal runtime opt-out established.

sources.title: plugins
sources.finding: Separate marketplace contains plugin manifests, skills, hooks, MCP configuration and UI plugins. GitHub/GitLab workflows require respective user-authenticated CLIs; external plugins and paid APIs retain their own code/data boundaries.

sources.title: github-plugin
sources.finding: Optional GitHub plugin instructs gh authentication, branch validation, explicit create/review/merge workflows. This is agent-executed CLI workflow, not native issue synchronization or server-enforced branch protection.

sources.title: usage-code
sources.finding: App Usage reads agent database model/turn/tool facts through usage/stats; provider credit dashboards stay separate and never silently fall back to local estimates. UI refresh is on access/manual action; provider TPS is cached five minutes.

sources.title: recording
sources.finding: Browser WebM recordings are copied atomically into local workspace paths or uploaded to the authorized remote workspace. Output path/type checks reject traversal; records are ordinary mutable files.

sources.title: Automation dispatch and manual-run claims
sources.finding: claimDue takes a transactional dispatch lock. markDispatched releases it after scheduled submission. Manual runNow retains a heartbeat-renewed lock through queueing and execution; cronRunLifecycle releases it at terminal outcome. Stale claims expire after ten minutes. This is not a whole-run lock across every scheduled execution.

sources.title: Persisted goal accounting
sources.finding: finishSessionTargetRun/accountSessionTargetUsage set budget_limited when completed-turn token accounting reaches the goal token budget. runtime/methods/target.ts only continues active goals. This is post-turn accounting, not a mid-request hard cap or global dollar invoice limit.

sources.title: CLI and desktop memory defaults
sources.finding: Shared CLI default features.memory is true; bootstrap runtime-config uses it unless overridden. packages/shared/src/validationAppSettings.ts defaults desktop memoryEnabled to false. Desktop documentation describes opt-in local-project memory.

sources.title: Computer Use public placeholder
sources.finding: createComputerUseRuntime.execute returns isError:true and Computer Use is not available in this build. The package manifest explicitly marks zcodeCuaPlaceholder:true; current official desktop documentation describes a separate available feature.

sources.title: Optional A2A agent delegation
sources.finding: The marketplace adapter launches a separately installed anet MCP node through bin/anet-mcp.sh and anet-run.sh. Documented tools find agents, send/wait/cancel tasks and reply. The external node/hub and remote agents have separate identities, configuration and payment boundaries; this does not name Claude Code or Codex as native ZCode task harnesses.

sources.title: Bot group authorization and attribution
sources.finding: Feishu/Lark group state binds owner, authorization ID, workspace, task and native input provenance; replies recheck bindings and use request hashes. botsService.ts initializes topic contexts only for enabled groups owned by the bound account. Group members can submit requests through the external platform, with a shared checkout; this is not native coediting or organization RBAC.

sources.title: Release and public-export identity
sources.finding: Release v4.0.0 was published 2026-11-23T08:14:37Z. Its public tag is a4b4445 while release notes identify build source 6d86cdaa161f70573e88ce1ad2d15ea767167285. Public export behavior cannot be equated to all private production build defaults.

sources.locator: target SHA resolution, final confirmation and gh release create --target
sources.finding: The release skill resolves an exact target SHA, asks confirmation and passes --target to gh release create. This is an optional instruction layer, not a universal enforced product release gate.
